name: Store Stats for WooCommerce
author: James Ridgway
description: Revenue, profit and order counts from any WooCommerce store in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Shows revenue, profit, margin and orders for a WooCommerce store. Add one widget per store, each with its own profile.

schema.label: Store profile
schema.description: Name of the store's saved connection. Use a different name for each store.

schema.label: Bar text
schema.description: Available fields: {revenue} {gross} {profit} {margin} {orders} {aov} {period}. Use just an icon to keep figures off the bar.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often today's orders are fetched.

schema.label: History refresh (minutes)
schema.description: How often earlier days are re-fetched to pick up refunds and status changes.

schema.label: Order statuses counted (comma separated)
schema.description: Add on-hold if you count bank transfer orders before payment arrives.

schema.label: Extra per-unit cost meta keys (comma separated)
schema.description: For cost plugins not detected automatically. Checked on order lines and products.

schema.label: Assumed margin for uncosted products (%)
schema.description: 0 leaves these products out of profit. Anything else adds an estimate, marked with ~.
